context: M12 o2. Herald Square lunch counter. Calloway two stools from the end, accordion file at her elbow. **Branch A.**

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Mr. Arce. I've watched you walk past my car four times. Tuna or egg salad?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: You're the woman in the parked car on Fifth.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Ruth Calloway. Special Prosecutor's office. Don't look around. Eat.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: You collect for Carl Mayhew. Mayhew collects for a lieutenant. Who collects for a lawyer.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: I'm not asking you to be brave, Mr. Arce. I'm asking you to be audible.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Wear a wire on your rounds. Your record goes away. And I protect you.

choices.text: Burn it. I'm not a rat.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Give me the thing. Before I finish this sandwich and change my mind.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: It goes under the undershirt. You'll sweat. Everybody sweats.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I waited in a car once and said nothing. I'm good at it. Find another man.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: Then you're a witness I'll subpoena instead of a witness I protect. Your choice.

lines.speaker: char.ruth_calloway
lines.text: I have a budget for coffee and a budget for you. Guess which is bigger.
